elevate.move: Move the build from the margin to the stage: as each layer section enters, its segment slides into the large plate and locks with a settle (nails drop for 06), so the roof assembles at full size while the sticky card only counts; the estimator replays that same assembly in reverse to lift out the touched layers.

Make the hero stack the first proof: on load the seven layers drop into place 01 to 07 with names typed beside them (static and complete under reduced motion), and on phone the stack lands above the fold in a shorter crop that never sits under the call bar.
